title: Thank you. We will write back within one business day.
body: A person reads every message. If Forcelis is not the right fit, that is the answer you will get.

types.asesor: You told us you advise businesses. We will come back with what the platform would look like for your client list.
types.fundador: You applied to the Founders programme. There are a limited number of places, and we answer in order of arrival.
types.individual: You requested access to the Individual plan. We will reply with how your access would work and which XML files you would need to download.
types.diagnostico: You asked for a diagnostic. We will come back with the scope and what we need from you.
types.monitoreo: You asked about Monthly Monitoring. We will come back with availability and how it starts.
